name: 角兽长毛披肩
description: A waist-length shawl of long hanging fur in clumps like grass, gray-green-brown.

name: 桦皮护胸
description: A chest guard pressed from white birch bark with black marks, leather cords crossing to tie at the back.

name: 林业护具
description: A canvas vest with hard shoulder pads and two reflective bands on the chest, wood shavings on the cuffs.

name: 搜救队绳索背心
description: A felt vest crossed by two thick ropes with metal carabiners, a small bell hanging at the back.

name: 科考站加热背心
description: An orange quilted vest with a battery box on the chest and one exposed cable; one indicator cell lit (emit).

name: 冬牙角盔
description: A closed-face war helm with a pair of back-curving horns, a narrow eye slit and a row of bone studs on the brow. Heavy class. Front view; it is the only helmet in the armour set.

name: 雪祀羽氅
description: A long white cloak with a ring of long feathers at the collar; the hem hung with red-yellow-blue woven bands and small bone pendants.

name: 雪顶护肩
description: Two rounded shoulder guards on a harness, a crust of packed white snow and ice on top, fur trim.

name: 空壳战袍
description: The husk's blue-grey fur robe with the eared hood, empty: dark inside the hood and sleeves, torn at the edges. It should feel hollow.

name: 泯灭护颈
description: A bone-and-antler gorget, a collar of plates on teal cloth with one plate cracked through.

name: 冲阵蹄铁
description: A heavy fur mantle whose front is covered in overlapping iron hoof-plates (horseshoe shapes).

name: 洁雪仪氅
description: A pure-white long feather cloak with a round bone clasp at the collar. It must differ from 雪祀羽氅: shorter feathers, no bands, cleaner.

name: 守望者皮甲
description: A leather jerkin with a fur collar and riveted chest plates; one warm-orange stitch on the chest ties it to the set's tinder box.

name: 族树木片
description: A thin slip of wood with bark on, three vertical cuts on its face, on a leather cord.

name: 鼷兽毛团
description: A white fluffy pompom pendant with a short little tail sticking out.

name: 幸运晶石
prototype: no photo: a raw clear crystal
description: An irregular clear crystal drilled at the top for a cord, with one crack inside catching light.

name: 骨缝雪镜
description: A curved bone plate with one thin horizontal slit, leather cords at both ends: Inuit-style snow goggles.

name: 手持定位仪
description: An orange handheld terminal with a small antenna and one blinking dot on its monochrome screen (emit).

name: 角兽银铃
description: One small silver bell on a piece of braided leather, a single arc engraved on it.

name: 黑雪结晶
description: A cluster of black snowflake-like crystals with a 1–2 px cold-blue glow at the edges (emit).

name: 猎首獠牙串
description: Five curved fangs on a leather cord, the middle one largest, a bit of woven band at the knot.

name: 结绳猎记
description: A knotted cord record: a leather cord with many knots and a bone toggle.

name: 猎人的耐心
prototype: no photo: a carved wooden hunting decoy
description: A small carved wooden decoy bird on a cord, worn smooth by a hand.

name: 置换指骨
description: A long finger bone ringed with black frost, its tip glowing faint pale violet (emit).

name: 壳中种子
description: A large seed in a cracked dark shell with one green sprout coming out.

name: 雪祀断冠
description: The broken half of a white antler crown with a violet glowing gem (emit).

name: 反馈赠之铃
description: A dark bronze bell crusted with frost, a violet glow at its mouth (emit). It must differ from 角兽银铃: darker, larger, cursed-looking.

name: 洁雪手鼓
prototype: no photo: a Sámi noaidi drum (search "Sámi drum")
description: An oval Sámi drum; the drum head painted with one tree and three human figures in red-brown.

name: 守望者火绒盒
description: A small round birch-bark box, its lid seam letting out one pixel of orange light (emit).
